facts.fact: Sierra Leone's National Communications Authority signed a protocol with Guinea to introduce free mobile roaming between the two countries, finalised at the 15th session of the African Council of Regulators (CAR-15) alongside the Transform Africa 2025 Summit supported by Smart Africa; the document gives no event day, so its published date is used.

note: Roaming not yet in effect: the document says NatCA will announce the activation date once operators implement it.
